newsitem.title: USA: Novametrix in distribution pact with Ambu.
newsitem.headline: Novametrix in distribution pact with Ambu.

text.p: Novametrix Medical Systems Inc said Monday it as signed a distribution agreement with Ambu Inc, a Danish company, to market its new line of hand-held monitors, Tidal Wave and Vent Check.
The products will be marketed through the North American sales organization of Ambu for the pre-hospital and emergency resuscitation equipment market.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

The hand-held, battery operated Tidal Wave carbon dioxide monitor aids in determining appropriate endotracheal intubation and will assist the paramedic in assessing the effectiveness of cardio-pulmonary resusciation by monitoring the carbon dioxide waveform and trend.
Vent Check allows a clinician to maintain appropriate ventilation and assure patient safety during transport by measuring flow, pressure, and volume at the airway.
Novametrix makes medical electronic instruments and sensors that non-invasively and continuously assess a critically ill patient's oxygen, carbon dioxide and respiratory mechanics.
